verdict.rationale: Abacum has a dedicated revenue-planning use case that connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model. It ingests CRM data and runs forecasts against live actuals, which covers building a revenue plan from pipeline and tracking it. The evidence is marketing-level first-party claims only. Missing for 10: explicit subscription/billing-data revenue modeling, detailed docs on plan-vs-actual variance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
